errors.evidence: The y-axis has no label. The description hallucinates a label, seemingly by taking part of the x-axis label.
The list of y-axis tick labels is incomplete; it omits the labels for 0.025, 0.100, and 0.175.
Describing the AU line as gradually increasing is an over-generalization. The line is flat from x=0.02 to x=0.1 before it begins to increase.
The final value for the blue "TU" line at x = 0.5 is approximately 0.193, not 0.13. The value 0.13 is reached at approximately x=0.2.
The blue line, designated "TU," is a solid line, not dashed.
The green line, designated "EU," has circular markers, not triangular ones. All three lines in the plot have circular markers.
